remediation_items: Line 4: 'hai thuật toán' should preferably be '$2$ thuật toán' to consistently format all numerical values in KaTeX.

Terminology order inconsistency: Several technical terms have Vietnamese placed first with English in parentheses (e.g., 'hiệu năng (performance)', 'các biến đầu vào (input variables)', 'yếu tố số trị (numerical factors)', 'yếu tố phân loại (categorical factors)', 'số lượng neuron (number of neurons)', 'kết quả mô phỏng (simulation results)', 'hành vi động thái (dynamic behavior)') instead of the required 'English (Vietnamese translation)' on first use.
summary: The fragment ch01_abstract_branches.md is highly faithful and completely captures all findings, hyperparameter counts, factors, simulation gains (>65%), keywords, and highlights from ch01.txt without hallucination. Heading levels (## Abstract at level 2, ### Highlights at level 3) and indentation hierarchy are correctly structured. KaTeX wrapping is applied to all key numeric data ($6$, $4$, $2$, $65\%$). Minor remediation points concern standardizing the English (Vietnamese) ordering for all technical terms and wrapping the word 'hai' as '$2$'.
